faqs.question: When is the Techcombank Ho Chi Minh City International Marathon taking place?
faqs.answer: The Techcombank Ho Chi Minh City International Marathon is scheduled to take place on December 6, 2026. This date marks the 9th edition of the race, which is held annually in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, drawing runners from various distance categories to participate in this international event.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this event?
faqs.answer: This event offers six distance options for participants to choose from: a full marathon of 42.195km, a half marathon of 21.1km, as well as shorter distances of 10km, 5km, 3km, and 1.5km, accommodating a wide range of runner experience levels and fitness goals.

faqs.question: Is registration open for this race?
faqs.answer: Yes, registration for the Techcombank Ho Chi Minh City International Marathon is currently open. Interested participants can register ahead of the December 6, 2026 event date, allowing sufficient time to prepare for their chosen distance, whether it be the full marathon or one of the shorter race options.

faqs.question: Where is the marathon held?
faqs.answer: The marathon is held in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, which serves as both the venue and host city for this international running event. As the 9th edition of the race, it continues to bring together runners from multiple distance categories in this major Vietnamese city.
